name: Mondstadt Hash Brown

descriptions.normal: A fried cake of mashed potatoes. A little bit of pinecone helps give it a nice crunch, and great with a bit of jam. Loved by people of all ages.
descriptions.suspicious: A fried cake of mashed potatoes. It's said that a hash brown without jam is not worthy of the Mondstadt name... But is this even a hash brown?
descriptions.delicious: A fried cake of mashed potatoes. Close your eyes and feel the mild breeze and sweet dew that Mondstadt offers.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1250 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 600 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1900 HP to the selected character.

recipeHint: Complete the Temple of the Wolf Domain
